items.summary:
No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia

A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a dramatic night-time explosion and the sinking of the vessel.

The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette that had stopped to refuel and take on supplies, according to Libyan officials from the country’s eastern government.

items.title: Germany taking seriously reports Russia may be planning to launch nuclear weapons into space
items.summary:
Move would be breach of Outer Space treaty and Partial Nuclear Test Ban treaty, which prohibit placing of nuclear weapons in orbit

The German government has said it is taking very seriously reports that Russia may be planning to launch a satellite armed with a ⁠nuclear weapon ⁠into ​space later this year.

The move – if confirmed – would be a breach of 1967 Outer Space treaty of which Moscow is a signatory as well the 1963 Partial Nuclear Test Ban treaty – which prohibit the placing of nuclear weapons in Earth’s orbit and test detonations in space.
